use: unit 3 records: record cards and «find it» tasks
approvalRule: approval.contentSha256 = first 16 hex of sha256 over {id, name, fact, caveat, disputed} (JSON, sorted keys, UTF-8). If any of these change, the approval no longer matches and the card must be re-approved before it is shown.

fact.en: Cuba is the largest island in the Caribbean region.

source.note: block 4 section 7 plan, approved by Svetlana 14.11.2026 («Утверждаю», rev 33)

fact.ru: Пико-Дуарте (3098 м) в Доминиканской Республике — высочайшая вершина островов Карибского бассейна.
fact.en: Pico Duarte (3,098 m) in the Dominican Republic is the highest peak of the Caribbean islands.

source.note: block 4 section 7 plan, approved by Svetlana 14.11.2026 («Утверждаю», rev 33)

fact.ru: Сент-Китс и Невис — самая маленькая страна Америки и по площади, и по населению.
fact.en: Saint Kitts and Nevis is the smallest country of the Americas both in area and in population.

source.note: block 4 section 7 plan, approved by Svetlana 14.11.2026 («Утверждаю», rev 33)

fact.ru: На Тринидаде лежит Асфальтовое озеро (Питч-Лейк) — крупнейшее в мире природное скопление асфальта.
fact.en: Pitch Lake on Trinidad is the largest natural deposit of asphalt in the world.

source.note: block 4 section 7 plan, approved by Svetlana 14.11.2026 («Утверждаю», rev 33)
